lines.text: Jesus, who holds the seven stars in His right hand, tells Ephesus they have persevered for His name.
Jesus holds against Ephesus that they abandoned their first love, and warns He will remove their altar if they do not repent.
Ephesus hates the works of the Nicolaitans, and the one who overcomes may eat from the tree of life.
Jesus, the First and the Last who died and returned to life, tells Smyrna He knows their affliction and poverty.
Jesus tells Smyrna not to fear, because the devil will throw some into prison, and they will suffer tribulation for forty days.
